So in 2024, we made a bold decision. We switched to a fixed price: KES 450,000 per Shopify store. Period.

1,200 repositories.

When we launched Patchwork CI, we promised it would always be free for open source. Plenty of people told us we were crazy. "How will you make money?" they asked.

Today we run on 1,200 repositories, and about 900 of them are open source.

But here's what really surprised me: across all those repos, 1 in 7 CI failures turned out to be a flaky test.

Let that sink in. 1 in 7.

That's countless hours of developer time wasted on red builds that weren't real failures.

Open source didn't just give us users. It gave us data, feedback, and a community. Our most-requested feature, GitLab support, came straight from OSS maintainers, and we shipped it on November 12.

Giving back isn't charity. It's strategy.
